name: chair leg extended stretch
description: Seated on the edge of a chair, extend one leg and hinge forward to stretch the hamstrings at the back of the thigh.
instructions: Sit near the front edge of a stable chair with one foot planted.
Extend the other leg forward with its heel on the floor and toes pointing up.
Keep your back long and hinge gently from the hips until you feel the stretch behind the extended thigh.
Hold without bouncing, then sit upright and switch legs.
